ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_aank: Fly with &dAppa&r to the &6Northern Water Tribe&r: a city of ice and canals behind a giant ice wall. The gate guard guh is strict, but very friendly once you wipe your paws.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_blau: Someone in a blue mask untied you. Sneak off the ship. Stay out of the guards' light.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_golf: Make &6three waves&r in the wave pool next to the square with &bWater Wave&r.
Climb to the &6Wave Pulpit&r above the gate. The ocean is waiting. Gently, right?
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_gond: Get into the gondola in the basin below the grand stairs and push it past the &6three stops&r with &bWater Current&r.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_have: Go to the harbor, to &cZhao Mika&r's ship. Watch out for nets.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_heme: Go to the &6Sky Pond&r, where Tui and La should be swimming. Only one of them is.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_ijsb: Stand at the end of the jetty, look at the islet and freeze a bridge with &bIce Bridge&r. Then walk across.
Find &dKoh the Face Stealer&r in the Spirit World. When he looks at you: don't move, don't jump, don't click anything.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_maan: Go to the &6spirit oasis&r behind the palace, through the little door in the ice.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_medi: Sit down by the pond (sneak) and meditate with &dAang Guh&r. Beware of wrong dimensions.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_pakg: Talk to &dMaster Pakguh&r on the training square. He only teaches guhs with a moustache. Luckily &dKatara Guh&r is there too.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_slee: Climb the ice wall west of the gate. Step onto the &dotter-penguin guh&r at the Slide Pulpit with an empty paw and slide down.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_stor: Follow the little light through the storm. Listen for &dAppa&r. Then chapter 2 is done: &dKatara Guh&r and &dSokka Guh&r travel with you.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_vis_: Sneak aboard &cZhao Mika&r's ship and take the moon fish out of the cage in the hold.
Bring the moon fish back to the pond in the oasis. &dYue Guh&r is waiting there.
Pay &dPrincess Yue Guh&r a visit in the palace. &dSokka Guh&r comes along. By coincidence.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h2_water_zwee: Hit the &6five targets&r on the training square with your power &bWater Whip&r (the power key).
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.golf: The wave pool is %s: the sunken pool with the jetty, just east of the targets. Stand at its edge or on the jetty, pick Water Wave and make three waves.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.golf_kanse: The Wave Pulpit is %s: the little balcony right above the gate in the ice wall. Take the stairs on the inside of the wall up and stand on the light.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.gondel: The gondola is %s, in the basin at the foot of the grand stairs. Get in, pick Water Current and push it where you look, past the three stops. The next stop lights up. Paddling is fine too.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.haven: The harbor is %s: out through the gate and then east, where Zhao Mika's big black ship lies. Walk onto the harbor.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.hemelvijve: The Sky Pond is %s: follow the path lanterns to the big water. Back in your body? Meditate again by the pond in the spirit oasis.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.ijsbrug: The islet with the pavilion is %s. Walk along the jetty to its end, look at the islet, pick Ice Bridge and use it. Then walk over the bridge: it stays for a minute.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.koh: Koh's Cave is %s: follow the path lanterns to the hollow roots of the ancient tree and walk into the Passage of Faces. When Koh looks at you: don't move, don't jump, don't click anything. Back in your body? Meditate again by the pond in the spirit oasis.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.mediteer: The pond is %s. Stand anywhere in the oasis, hold sneak and keep still for three counts. Above your hotbar the counts tick down.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.oase: The spirit oasis is %s: all the way up, behind the palace. Walk round the palace and go through the little door in the ice.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.ontsnap: You're on the ship. The harbor is %s: up the stairs behind the tower, behind the barrels round the funnel, and down the ladder to the pier. Stay out of the guards' cones of little flames and sneak.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.pakguh: Master Pakguh is %s, on the training square: through the gate in the ice wall, north along the great canal and up the grand stairs. Talk to him (right-click).
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.slee: The Slide Pulpit is %s, up on the ice wall, west of the gate. Take the stairs on the inside of the wall up, click an otter-penguin guh with an empty hand and steer by looking (W pushes, S brakes). If you fall off, you're back at the top in a moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.storm: The light is %s. Walk straight at it through the snow and listen for Appa's roar. If you walk out of the storm, Zuka pulls you back.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.vis_halen: Back in your body! The harbor is %s, outside the gate on the east side. Start behind the barrels, climb the ladder on the side of the ship, sneak round the funnel and down the stairs behind the tower to the cell at the back of the hold. The moon fish hangs there in a cage.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.vis_terug: Bring Tui back quickly: the islet in the pond of the spirit oasis is %s, behind the palace. Just walk there.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.yue: The great door of the palace is %s, at the very top of the city. Go inside: Princess Yue Guh stands in the throne hall, by her father's seat. Talk to her.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.zweep: The five targets stand %s, in a row on the east edge of the square. Pick Water Whip, look straight at a target (from close by) and use your power. Each target counts once.
gui.guhs.kledingbron.einde2_h2_water: The Guhvatar, chapter 2: the Northern Water Tribe
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_h2_water.r: With the wind in your ears you fly through the void on Appa's back.
Far away, above a sea that has no business being here, floats a mountain of ice.
On it stands a city of canals and snow, behind a wall as high as a cloud.
The Northern Water Tribe. Home of the best waterbender in the Guheinde.
He has a moustache. That turns out to matter.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.kort.4: An ice bridge to the islet
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.0: Fly on Appa to the Northern Water Tribe. Not on Appa? Click him and pick the golden star.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.1: Talk to Master Pakguh on the training square: through the gate in the ice wall, north along the great canal and up the grand stairs.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.10: Go to the spirit oasis: all the way up, behind the palace, through the little door in the ice.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.11: Stand by the pond in the spirit oasis, hold sneak and keep still for three counts: then you meditate with Aang Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.12: In the Spirit World, follow the path lanterns to Koh's Cave. When Koh looks at you: don't move, don't jump, don't click anything. Back in your body? Meditate again by the pond in the spirit oasis.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.13: In the Spirit World, follow the path lanterns to the Sky Pond, where Tui and La should be swimming. Back in your body? Meditate again by the pond in the spirit oasis.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.14: Go to the harbor outside the gate (east), sneak aboard Zhao Mika's ship and take the moon fish out of the cage in the cell at the back of the hold.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.15: Bring the moon fish back to the islet in the pond of the spirit oasis, behind the palace.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.16: Climb the stairs on the inside of the ice wall to the Wave Pulpit, the little balcony right above the gate, and stand on the light.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.17: Walk through the blizzard on the glacier to the light and listen for Appa's roar. If you walk out of the storm, Zuka pulls you back.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.2: Hit the five targets on the east edge of the training square with your power Water Whip (hold the power key and pick it).
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.3: Make three waves with Water Wave in the wave pool: the sunken pool with the jetty, just east of the training square.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.4: Stand at the end of the jetty in the wave pool, look at the islet and use Ice Bridge. Then walk over the bridge to the islet.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.5: Climb the ice wall west of the gate to the Slide Pulpit, click an otter-penguin guh with an empty hand and slide down to the snow heap below.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.6: Get into the gondola in the basin below the grand stairs and push it with Water Current past the three glowing stops: by the gate, on the west canal and on the east canal.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.7: Go all the way up to the palace in the north of the city, through the great door, and talk to Princess Yue Guh in the throne hall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.8: Go to the harbor outside the gate, on the east side, where Zhao Mika's black ship lies: Sokka Guh has seen something.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.9: Sneak off Zhao Mika's ship, back to the barrels on the harbor. Stay out of the guards' cones of little flames; crouching, they don't see you as far.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.klaa: Done! You can waterbend, nyeg. Katara Guh and Sokka Guh travel with you to Ba Sing Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.uitleg: At the edge of the Guheinde floats a city of ice. There you learn waterbending from the strictest master with the longest moustache, meet the Blue Spirit, travel to the Spirit World and make a wave as high as a wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.1: The training square (above the grand stairs)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.14: The FNS Scorch Mark (in the harbor)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.3: The wave pool (east of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.5: The Slide Pulpit (on the ice wall, west of the gate)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.6: The canals of the lower city
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.7: The palace (at the top of the city)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.kl: On the way to Ba Sing Guh
item.guhs.boemerang.lore: From Sokka Guh. Throw it: it always comes back, with everything it met along the way
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.aankomst.aang: Look, a city of ice! At the top of the grand stairs is the training square. The best waterbender of the Guheinde lives there. Come on!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.aankomst.klaa: You're standing on the landing ice before the gate of the Northern Water Tribe. Ice, canals and guhs in thick coats everywhere.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.geest.aang: We're here! The real Spirit World this time. Don't stare at the sky too long, it acts weird.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.geest.geen_we: There is no Spirit World in this world. The story goes on without it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.geest.weer: Your soul sniffs on in the Spirit World once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.golf.klaar: Your waves are getting prettier than mine. Don't tell Pakguh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.gondel.katara: When you're done sliding around: there's a gondola in the basin below the grand stairs. Push it through the canals with waterbending.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.gondel.klaar: Nicely sailed! Say... have you met Princess Yue Guh yet? In the palace? I'll come along. To... see the palace.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.haven.net: A net falls over you. Fire Nation Mikas jump out from behind the barrels. Everything goes dark...
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ijsbrug.hier_: There's nothing to freeze here. Try it at the end of the jetty in the wave pool.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ijsbrug.kijk: Look at the islet when you freeze the bridge.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ijsbrug.klaar: Water can flow and water can stand still. Now you can do both. My lessons are over for today.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ijsbrug.staat: A bridge of ice, just for you. Quick, it stays for a minute!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.klaar.1: Chapter 2 is done! You can waterbend. From now on Katara Guh and Sokka Guh travel with you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.klaar.2: You get a Water Tribe Parka for your guh and Sokka Guh's boomerang. Appa takes you all to Ba Sing Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.klaar.boemera: Here, take my boomerang. I have another one. It always comes back. Just like me. And just like you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.klaar.geen_vl: Appa doesn't know the way to Ba Sing Guh yet. Whistle for him later: he'll take you there once he knows the city.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.aang: You did it! You didn't pull a single face! I almost laughed myself.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.fout: Koh has borrowed your face. It comes back by itself. You're at the mouth of his cave again: walk in and try once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.fout.bewe: Ah! You moved. That was a feeling. May I borrow that little face? I'll give it back later, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.fout.klik: Your hand slipped. What lovely nerves. What a lovely face.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.fout.spri: A little jump! From fright, or from joy? Both lovely. Both mine.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.0: Koh looks at you with the face of a guh...
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.1: ...now with the face of a Mika. He grins.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.2: ...now he laughs. Very loudly. Don't laugh along.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.3: ...now he looks very sad. Don't cry along.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.4: ...a guh again. He sniffs at your ear.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.goed.1: Mmmm. Not a single wrinkle. A pity. You have a lovely face.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.goed.2: The moon and the ocean hold each other. Push one away, and the other loses itself in rage.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.goed.3: Go to the Sky Pond, Guhvatar. See what happens when the balance is gone.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.ondertite: Don't move. Don't jump. Don't click anything.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.weer: Ahhh. There you are again. Let's try once more. Look at me.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.kracht.uitleg: New power: %1$s! Hold %2$s and pick it in your power wheel. Then tap %2$s to use it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.la.aang: Quick! Back to our bodies. We have to bring Tui back before La makes the whole sea angry.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.maanvis.aang: I can feel the moon getting weaker. Come and sit by the pond. We're going to meditate.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.mediteer.hoe: Hold sneak and keep still to meditate.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.mediteer.weg: Your concentration is gone. Sit down quietly again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ontsnap.aang: There you are! Quick, to the spirit oasis behind the palace. I can feel something is wrong with the moon.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ontsnap.klaar: You're off the ship! Nobody saw you. There's no trace of the Blue Spirit.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ontsnap.maske: On the jetty lies a little blue mask. Just the right size for a guh. Strange.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.pakguh.zweep: First lesson: the water whip. There are five targets. Hit all five. I am watching. My moustache is watching too.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.bewoner.0: Ice, ice and more ice. And sea prunes. Want a sea prune? Nobody ever wants a sea prune.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.bewoner.1: Have you seen the Wave Pulpit yet, above the gate? Nobody ever stands up there. Too high. Too cold. Too epic.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.bewoner.b: The Fire Nation! All guhs inside! ...I mean: all waterbending guhs OUTSIDE!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.bewoner.n: That wave! Did you see it? The whole fleet drifted gently into the void. Nobody hurt. Only Zhao's pride.
I wave at the moon every night. Sokka Guh does too. He waves for a very long time.
Welcome to the Northern Water Tribe, Guhvatar. My ice is your ice. Don't slip.
Zhao Mika's fleet lies before the wall. My warriors hold the gate. You... you hold our hope.
My daughter shines over the city every night now. I'm proud of her. And of you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.0: Won't Pakguh teach you anything either? Just wait. I have a plan. It's called: challenging him.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.be: Everything is gray without the moon. Even Sokka's jokes. Though those were always a bit gray.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.go: Go to the Wave Pulpit above the gate. I can feel it: the ocean is waiting for you.
Push the gondola through the canals with waterbending. The stops are by the gate, on the west canal and on the east canal.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.kl: I'm coming with you, Guhvatar. Someone has to teach you to wash your own socks. With water.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.sl: Sokka wants to go otter surfing. I wouldn't. ...I'm totally going to.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.tr: Water flows, it doesn't push. Move with it, not against it. That's what Pakguh says. I say: just hit that target.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.yu: Sokka is in love. He's acting very weird. Even weirder than usual.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.0: Another tourist. Go to the market, they sell stick-on moustaches there.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.be: The Fire Nation stands before the wall. A good waterbender stays as calm as the ice. ...I am very calm. Very. Calm.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.go: Stand by the wave pool and make three waves. No splashing. Waves.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.ij: Water can also stand still. Stand at the end of the jetty, look at the islet and freeze the way across.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.kl: You have become a true waterbender, Guhvatar. Without a moustache. Perhaps I should rewrite my rules.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.vr: My lessons are over for today. Go and play with your moustacheless friends.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.zw: Five targets. A whip of water. Hit them all. Moustache or no moustache.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.poortwach: Halt! ...Oh, you again. Go on through. Wipe your paws.
The Guhvatar! Everyone is talking about that wave. I was there. I got very wet.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.0: Waterbending isn't for me. I have a boomerang. A boomerang always comes back. A boomerang never lets you down.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.bel: I have a plan for the siege. Step one: don't get captured. Step two: ...still working on that.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.gon: Gondola riding is just like otter surfing. But wetter. And slower. And without an otter.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.kla: I'm coming too! Who else is going to make the plans? And the jokes. Especially the jokes.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.sle: Otter surfing! Climb the ice wall, west of the gate. An otter-penguin guh is waiting at the top. Empty paws on it, and GO!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.yue: Have you seen Princess Yue Guh? In the palace? Did she say anything about me? Tell her I'm funny. And tall.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.storm_zuk: Stay there. When the storm dies down, I'm taking you with me. Then I get my honor back.
It's... pretty cold. Not that I'm cold. I'm never cold. I'm from the Fire Nation.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.wacht.0: Move along. This is a Fire Nation ship. No cuddling here.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.yue.0: Welcome to the palace, Guhvatar. My father says the moon shines more beautifully here than anywhere else. He's right.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.yue.beleg: They say I was born with the power of the moon. I can feel her getting weaker now. Be careful.
I'm still here, Guhvatar. Every night. Tell Sokka he can stop waving. ...Or actually: don't let him stop.
The moon and the ocean keep each other in balance. Just like you will, with all four elements. On to Ba Sing Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.zhao.0: I am Admiral Zhao Mika! I am going to make history! ...What are you looking at? Shoo, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.zhao.1: Have you seen my ship? Impressive, huh? Don't touch anything. Especially not the buttons.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.slee.klaar: WAAAHOO! Again! ...I mean: that was very grown-up and useful.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.slee.opnieuw: Almost! The otter is waiting for you at the top again. Once more!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.slee.sokka: Psst! Done with the lesson? Then we go OTTER SURFING. Up on the ice wall, west of the gate. Bring an empty paw.
HEY! A guh! Back you go!
Who goes there? ...Back to your spot, little one!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.sluip.terug: Spotted! You're put back. Try again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.sluip.uitleg: The guards see everything in their cone (the little flames). Sneak past: crouching, they don't see you as far. Seen? Then you start again at your last rest point.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.storm.gegrepe: While everyone cheers, someone grabs you by the scruff. A hot breath. Then only snow...
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.storm.terug: The blizzard won't let you go. You're back with Zuka.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.stroom.geen_w: Water Current only works in the water, or in your gondola.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.vis.gepakt: Carefully you lift the bag with the moon fish out of the cage. Tui is limp and gray. Hurry!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.vis.katara: I'll distract the guards! Go, take Tui to the pond!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.yue.1: Welcome, Guhvatar. I have heard a lot about you. Mostly from Sokka Guh. He talks a lot.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.yue.2: Me? Talk a lot? No. Hardly. Almost never. Nice palace, by the way. Nice... walls.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.yue.3: You're funny, Sokka Guh. ...But listen. This morning our scouts saw smoke above the sea.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.yue.4: Smoke? Like from a campfire? A cozy, small, innocent campfire?
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.yue.5: Like from a fleet. The Fire Nation is coming. Admiral Zhao Mika is already in the harbor with his ship.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.yue.6: Everyone to their posts. Guhvatar: see what Zhao Mika is up to at the harbor. And be careful.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.yue_maan.klaa: The moon glows again. The colors are back. But the fleet is still in front of the wall.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.zweep.klaar: Not bad. Not bad at all. For a guh without a moustache.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.aang: I'm Aang Guh! And this is the new Guhvatar. We've come to learn waterbending!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.halt: Halt! Who goes there, flying in on a... six-legged plushie?
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.intr: The Northern Water Tribe. A city of ice at the edge of the world. Well: at the edge of the Guheinde.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.open: The Guhvatar? Here? ...Open the gate! And someone go wake Master Pakguh.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.pakg: Pakguh is the best waterbender in the city. Come on, nyeg!
The hold of the FNS Scorch Mark. You're tied to a post. Dark. Damp. It smells of charcoal and lost honor.
The Blue Spirit says nothing. He puts a finger to his mask: hush.
Sneak off the ship. Stay out of the guards' light. When you sneak, they don't see as far.
A feather under the nose. A yawn. And the guard sleeps like a baby Mika.
He unties your ropes and points at the stairs. Outside. And then he's gone, as quietly as he came.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.di: i think... we ended up in the wrong parallel dimension.....
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.ec: For real this time. Promise. Hehe.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.fo: Oh wait.. my bad... we were supposed to go here hehe
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.ge: CONGRACHONKULATIONS ON YOUR 10 CARPACCIO STREAK AT LA CUBANITA JOOSTCHONKY AND SUUSCHONKY!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.gl: Then your tattoos begin to glow. Soft blue first. Then brighter. Then SO white that even the pond gets a fright.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.li: Your bodies stay sitting quietly by the pond. Your souls sniff on, nyeg. To the right world this time.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.ti: The Journey to the Spirit World
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.va: ... ummmm... Those aren't the chonkies we thought.....
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.zi: Eyes closed. Breathe in... breathe out... think of nothing. Except nibbles. No, not of nibbles either.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.gloed: Your eyes glow. You feel the ocean. It's angry, but it listens to you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.golf: A wave as high as the ice wall rolls out over the sea. It lifts the ships, ever so carefully, and carries them away. Far away. Into the void.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.jij: You did it! You moved the ocean! Well, the ocean moved you. Together!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.kun: Can you do this? The ocean is big. Really very big.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.la: From the sea rises a giant glowing koi. La, the Ocean Spirit. She looks at you. She waits.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.maar: ...But someone else has been waiting too. Behind you, in the shadow of the tower.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.nee: No! My fleet! My HISTORY! ...Is this a barrel? I'm sitting on a barrel.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.niemand: Nobody is hurt. The Mikas bob home on driftwood and barrels. A few even wave. Gently, that is.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.rust: The sea grows calm. The moon shines. And for the first time in days you can catch your breath...
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.samen: You're not doing it alone. La will help you. Let the ocean flow through you... and don't forget: gently. Nobody may get hurt.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.trots: Roku Guh would be proud of you. So am I. Very much.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.vloot: Zhao Mika's fleet lies in front of the ice wall. Dozens of cannons. Hundreds of Mikas. And one Guhvatar on a little ledge.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_golf.tek: The wave pool. Waves, not splashes.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_golf_kan: The Wave Pulpit. The ocean is waiting for you here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_gondel.t: The gondola, in the basin below the grand stairs.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_haven.te: The harbor. Zhao Mika's ship lies there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_mediteer: The pond of the moon and the ocean.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_oase.tek: The little door to the spirit oasis.
There's the harbor. Sneak over there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_pakguh.t: Master Pakguh. The longest moustache in the Guheinde.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_slee.tek: The Slide Pulpit. The otters are ready.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_storm.te: There! A little light in the storm.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_vis_hale: The harbor. Start behind the barrels.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_vis_teru: Back to the pond. Tui is in a hurry.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_yue.teks: The palace. Yue Guh is waiting inside.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_zweep.te: Five targets. One water whip per target.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_knipoog_balto: Snow at last! Nomguh must be here...
Did that one have a moustache?
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_knipoog_sjokk: Shuckly. On his way to the finish. He's almost there. Well... almost.
On the rim of the palace terrace someone is crawling past. Very. Slowly.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.grot: Koh's Cave. Hundreds of faces stare at you from the walls. And then something moves in the dark.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.succes: Good luck. Don't laugh. Not even at his moustache. He has no moustache. That's exactly why.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.vraag: You want to know about the moon and the ocean. Then first you must do something for me. Stand still. Look at me. And feel... nothing.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.waarschuw: Psst! Whatever happens: show NO emotion. Don't move, don't jump, don't click anything. Or he takes your face.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.welkom: Ahhh... the Guhvatar. It has been a long time. I liked your previous face better, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_la_woede.maan: Without the moon the ocean loses its balance. We have to bring Tui back. Quick, back to our bodies!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_la_woede.vijv: The Sky Pond. Tui is gone. La swims alone... and La is ANGRY.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_la_woede.visi: A vision: a giant ocean spirit, red with rage, swallowing Zhao Mika's whole fleet. And the Water Tribe with it.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.gesch: Admiral Zhao Mika makes history! Whoever has the moon has the Water Tribe. Grab that fish!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.grijs: Tui is gone. La swims her circles alone. And then the color drains out of everything.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.koh: We have to go to the Spirit World. To Koh. He knows how to save the moon.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.lach: Hahaha! Now the moon is MINE. ...I mean: the Fire Nation's. But mostly mine.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.nee: No! Without the moon fish there is no moon. And without the moon, no waterbending!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.oase: The spirit oasis: the only warm spot in the Water Tribe. Here Tui and La, the moon and the ocean, have been circling each other for a thousand years.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.domste: A MOUSTACHE? That's the silliest rule in the whole Water Tribe!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.dus: So you are the new Guhvatar. Hmm. And you want to learn waterbending.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.goed: Very well. I will train you both. Moustache or no moustache.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.kom_op: Come on, Guhvatar. Show him what a guh without a moustache can do!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.oud: The silliest rules are often the oldest, young lady.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.snor: I only teach guhs with a moustache. It has always been that way and that is how it stays. Look at my moustache. That is a moustache.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.uitdag: Then I challenge you. Here, on the square. If I win, you train the Guhvatar. And me.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.zweep: ...You have a strong whip, Katara Guh. And an even stronger will.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.e: At last, Guhvatar. You thought you were rid of me. Nobody is ever rid of me.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.g: Follow the light. Walk through the storm. Zuka is too cold to stop you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.k: Zuka acts tough, but his ears are shaking. It's freezing. And far off, through the white storm... you see a little light.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.w: Somewhere on the glacier. We wait until the storm dies down. Then I take you home. To MY home. Then I get my honor back.
Everything is white. There's snow in your ears, in your nose and in your nibble pouch. You're lying in the middle of a blizzard.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.gevonden: Appa sniffed you out. No offense. You smell like Zuka. That one is meant as offense.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.ja: Of course. You need a water teacher. And Sokka needs... us.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.niemand_: ...Then we take him along to the city, wrapped in Appa's blanket. We leave nobody behind in the snow. Not even him.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.plan: I already have a plan! ...Step one: Appa.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.team: Katara Guh, Sokka Guh... will you come with us? To Ba Sing Guh?
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.zuka: Zuka is still lying back there... in the snow. He's cold.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.belo: Every night. Even when it's cloudy. Then I'll just look harder.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.dank: I'm still here. Just look up. I'm always here, Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.geve: I'm giving it back. I won't become less, Sokka Guh. I'll become... more. I'll become the moon. And I'll look at you every night.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.ik: It isn't too late. When I was little, the moon gave me a piece of her light. I have carried it with me all this time.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.lich: A soft light shoots up, through the opening in the glacier, straight into the sky. The moon glows again. All the color flows back into the world.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.maan: Above the Northern Water Tribe the moon shines brighter than ever. A tiny bit pink. With two little ears, if you look closely.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.nee: No... he's still alive, but he's so weak...
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.niet: Yue... what are you going to do? You're not going to do anything silly, are you? That's MY job.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.nu: Tui lives. But Zhao Mika's fleet is still in front of the wall. Come on. The ocean is waiting for us.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.teru: You put the moon fish back in the pond. But Tui barely moves. He's too weak. The moon in the sky stays gray.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.zwaa: ...I'll wave at you later. Don't laugh. From now on everyone's going to wave at the moon.
